text: well idk tbh we are trying to figure out why the iso3d map editor all of a sudden stopped showing a grid and buildings but inside of the compiled game route its totally fine

events.text: Editor grid+buildings vanish / compiled route fine. Confirmed in framework/gpu/3d.zig: drawScene pass-1 (line ~1568) does 'if internGeometry()==null continue' — when g_retained_vbuf (the intern vertex buffer) is full, the mesh is silently dropped. The compiled route is fine because it draws baked g_static_inst_buf, not the live intern cache. CAVEAT: the 'cache-full degrade path' the line-113 comment promises is a PHANTOM — g_vertex_buffer is allocated+released but never written or bound, so there is NO fallback. ALSO: the prior session's comment blaming the imported mesh is wrong — Desk.glb is only 498 verts, not the cliff. So either (a) accumulated carve/humanoid geometry fills the 512k cap, or (b) the vanish is unrelated to intern (note recent iso-pane 'vanishing' fixes). Definitive test: rebuild (now boots since the 400MiB buffer crash is fixed) and read the [r3d-census] line — inst_seen>0 inst_collected==0 + retained near cap == intern-full confirmed. My buffer fix also raised usable intern from 16MiB to 112MiB (7x), which may already resolve it.

resolution: Iso-pane grid + buildings vanished while the compiled route was fine. Root cause (census-proven, not the prior session's buffer theory): the bridge-cost geometry dedup gates a mesh's verts behind a GLOBAL optimistic markShipped(key) set; JS flips it at render time but the host interns at paint time, so any box-keyed mesh that renders without reaching the host intern call desyncs the set and every later mesh with that key ships key-only, misses lookupGeometry, and is dropped. Census showed inst_seen=15 inst_collected=0 with retained=32k/3670k (buffer 0.9% full), killing the buffer-size theory. Fix: instanced buckets always ship their one geometry payload (the dedup saves nothing for an instanced bucket), so they self-describe and repopulate the shared Box key the grid lines cache-hit off. Verified: grid + buildings returned on hot-reload.
